fields.Name: Skip ICF - Top 10 Most Engaged Members
fields.Description: Cross-domain engagement ranking using conference attendance, course enrollments, committee service, certifications, competition entries and advocacy. Ported from "Top 10 Most Engaged Members" (chapters replaced by committees/advocacy).

InputDefinition.userMessage: Who are our top 10 most engaged members based on conference attendance, course enrollments, committee service, certifications, competition entries and advocacy actions? Show a ranked table with each metric. I want to click any member to open their profile. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a ranked table of 10 members
Engagement metrics come from at least four different domains (events, learning, committees, certifications, competitions, advocacy)
Each metric is shown as its own column and the ranking method is explained
Names are real people from the data, not placeholders
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
